purpose: Show whether transcription errors concentrate in degraded audio: per-clip word error rate inside flagged segments versus inside clean segments.
filter: rows where both wer_flagged and wer_clean are non-null
encodings: scatter with a diagonal y = x reference line; points colored by degradation class (fixed order by count), sized by word count (legend for sizes); annotate with the pooled error rates from summary.json key H2 (error rate inside vs outside flagged) in a corner text box; axis limits equal and starting at 0

axes.x: word error rate in clean segments
axes.y: word error rate in flagged (degraded) segments

caption: Per-clip word error rate inside AADD-flagged audio against the rate in clean audio for whisper-tiny on the test sample. Points above the diagonal mean more errors in degraded audio. The pooled rates are close, so hypothesis H2 (errors concentrate in degraded audio) is refuted.
